why_x1_failed.mechanism: The class-agnostic FCOS teacher found most objects, but the independently trained closed-set crop classifier rejected teacher proposal crops at every allowed VAL threshold; false candidate rate and two area subgates also failed.

why_x2_did_not_run.mechanism: Three official distribution channels yielded no non-empty Grounding DINO checkpoint bytes, so the prerequisite failed closed before inference. This is not a performance failure.

x3_change.detector: Torchvision FCOS ResNet50-FPN initialized from official COCO_V1 weights
x3_change.head: Direct three-class plastic_bottle/metal_can/paper_litter classification and box regression
x3_change.asset_availability: Official FCOS cache already present and exact expected SHA-256 verified
x3_change.license_release_boundary: Torchvision BSD-3-Clause code and documented reference-weight provenance; trained checkpoint remains repository-external until qualification.

unchanged_conditions: same QA-passed G4 train and VAL data
threshold and checkpoint selection use train_world_holdout only
full VAL and D1-D5 fixed static gates
no G5 sealed-final read before candidate freeze
existing leaf and puddle models remain unchanged
